blob_lifecycle_check.name: blob_lifecycle_check
blob_lifecycle_check.value:
("mail0_blob"."status" = 'pending' AND "mail0_blob"."ready_at" IS NULL AND "mail0_blob"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("mail0_blob"."status" = 'ready' AND "mail0_blob"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "mail0_blob"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("mail0_blob"."status" = 'deleting' AND "mail0_blob"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL)

mailbox_account_role_active_uidx.name: mailbox_account_role_active_uidx
mailbox_account_role_active_uidx.where: "mail0_mailbox"."role" IS NOT NULL AND "mail0_mailbox"."deleted_at" IS NULL

submission_attempt_lifecycle_check.name: submission_attempt_lifecycle_check
submission_attempt_lifecycle_check.value:
("mail0_submission_attempt"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "mail0_submission_attempt"."outcome" IS NULL)
          OR ("mail0_submission_attempt"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "mail0_submission_attempt"."outcome" IS NOT NULL)
